howto.name: Upload an SRT / VTT / ASS subtitle file
howto.text: Auto-detects format from extension and content.

faq.q: What's the difference between SRT and VTT?
faq.a: SRT: simplest. VTT (WebVTT): used by HTML5 <track>, supports styling. ASS (Advanced SubStation Alpha): rich styling like karaoke colors, but less compatible.
SRT → VTT: yes. VTT → SRT: styling is stripped (SRT has no style support). ASS → SRT: styling lost; text and timing preserved.
